CPU_observation_window: All stored resident samples, including noise startup, bulk traffic and migration; main-window peaks retained separately.
acceptance: Qualified 25,000/s noise; useful sender within 1% and receiver within 5% of 6000/s; zero missing unique UDP sequences in complete inner captures; 200/200 ordinary and 100/100 frequent probes within one second; no client/control guard, NFQUEUE/netlink/emulator/capture drops or noise leases. CPU is recorded without a threshold. Raw iperf loss estimates do not define VPN delivery.

method.noise: 25,000/s for 70 seconds; one source, 64 ports, 4096-datagram bursts; captured transport prefix plus altered ciphertext
method.useful: 6000 UDP application datagrams/s, 128 bytes; iperf3 -u -b 6144000 -l 128 --pacing-timer 1000 -t 60 -O 0 -J; -R for download
method.directions: Upload: fixed 300-ms RTT and 300/30-ms RTT/jitter. Download: 300/30 ms. Both source-IP-only and IP plus NAT-port moves, 25 seconds after workload launch.
method.ordinary_probe: 100 per profile, 500-ms nominal interval, one-second deadline
method.frequent_probe: 100 from profile 1, 50-ms nominal interval, one-second deadline, launch at second 23
method.WAN: 150-ms netem delay each way, optional normal 30-ms jitter each way; VPN and mutual TLS delayed; 16,384-packet queues; no configured loss
method.CPU: All stored nominal 250-ms resident samples and rolling four-sample windows. No runtime or build CPU quota or affinity changes.
method.capture: Full inner UDP/ICMP captures at both ends. Unique-sequence parsing handles GSO/GRO and a short four-byte startup-ACK tail. Upload also captures outer replies; download uses buffered inner UDP captures after the excluded heavy-capture failure.

return_recovery_limits.ownership: SHA-256 of peer public key plus scalar keypair creation time and local index; no plaintext or keypair pointers
return_recovery_limits.handoff_order: The sender remembers an encrypted packet before reading its endpoint. The receiver commits an authenticated new endpoint before the cache snapshot.

excluded_full_outer_capture.cause: Full encrypted reverse-path tcpdump capture dropped frames; switch reverse delivery controls to buffered inner UDP captures.

excluded_iperf_startup.UDP_error: unable to read from stream socket:

excluded_direction_assertion.cause: Old harness asserted forward direction for an intentional reverse UDP run after saving its raw row.

snapshot_handoff_localization.hypothesis: Outbound packet generated while synchronous replay still ran before endpoint commit; move endpoint commit ahead of cache snapshot.

benchmark_startup_patch.evidence: The original benchmark client failed before the first interval. A valid ACK was the four-byte tail of a 132-byte GRO frame after 126 full data datagrams. Upstream 3.18 reads four bytes at a time and permits 65 reads for 128-byte tests; the separate benchmark build raises the reorder bound from 2 to 256 (8193 reads). VPN client binaries and profiles are unchanged.

unchanged_from_v21: Python flow-confirmation agent and its tests
native VPN clients, profiles, keys and ports32497/32498
production servers, user VPN, Windows networking and personal JSON
scope_limits: The six final 500-ms trials are bounded observations and do not establish a lossless-roaming guarantee.
Shorter history may lose coverage at larger delays or later client transmissions; only RTT300ms was tested here.
Key changes, rapid/concurrent moves, cache eviction and replay-window limits may prevent recovery.
Replays are synchronous and add traffic; a registered peer can trigger bounded amplification without proving return reachability.
Repeated ciphertext can link paths and alter DPI-visible patterns; no DPI or unlinkability test was performed.
No physical Windows/macOS/Android/iOS GUI clients or production VPS operated.
Only one noise source with64ports; distributed noise and candidate exhaustion remain untested.
Inner captures prove delivery through VPN decryption; they do not prove iperf credited or the application consumed every datagram.
